descriptionChirho: Aramaic feminine noun meaning word, matter, thing, or affair. Found exclusively in Daniel (Dan 2:5-23; 3:22,28; 4:31,33; 5:10,15,26; 6:12,14; 7:1,11,16,25,28). In singular emphatic form millethāʾ it denotes a royal decree, judicial matter, or divine word (Dan 4:31 'the word fell from heaven'; Dan 6:12 'the matter of the decree'). In plural millīn/millayyāʾ it means 'words' spoken against God (Dan 7:25) or prophetic words recorded (Dan 7:1). Multilingual glosses consistently render: arb kalima (word), deu Wort, spa palabra/asunto, hin bāt/vachan, kor mal (word). No semantic distinction exists between the auto-split clusters; all are inflectional variants of the same Aramaic noun.
